This is a brief summary and breakdown of what we fish for and some highlights of what the fishing action is like at different times of the year. Feel free to give us a call at anytime so we can discuss what fishing is like during each season and what to expect on your catfish guide trip. Fall is an amazing time of the year for fishing. blurb: Guests book guided fishing trips for catfish on various North Texas lakes. The service provides all bait, tackle, rods, reels, and equipment; guests only need to bring food, drinks, and a Texas fishing license. Trips target blue catfish, channel catfish, flathead catfish, and trophy catfish using rod and reel techniques during daylight hours.
